dedupe_keys.name: remix model input data for the thg95 ghg95 scenario analysed within the museko project

description: The MuSeKo project deposits input data for a REMix energy-system scenario called THG95 or GHG95. Zenodo lists a public macro-enabled XLSM workbook under CC BY 4.0. Its description identifies techno-economic assumptions, energy demand, renewable potential, fuel and emission prices and infrastructure capacity for 2020, 2030, 2040 and 2050. The geographic model covers Germany, neighbouring countries, Italy, Norway and Sweden. Version 2 corrects German biogas potentials. These assumptions could be used to rerun or compare long-term power and sector-coupling plans in REMix or a similar model. The file is an input dataset, not the REMix executable or a verified output scenario. A German-language project report is linked for further details, but its PDF was not downloaded. The XLSM was not opened and its macros were not run; values, sheet names and external references remain unchecked. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this named MuSeKo scenario workbook.
name: REMix model input data for the THG95/GHG95 scenario analysed within the MuSeKo project
